is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis (page 1, abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotyped for kdr L1014F and L1014S (page 5, 'kdr genotyping').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports that 50 colony, 50 archived field, and 170 F1 field mosquitoes were genotyped and all were homozygous wild-type (page 5, 'kdr genotyping').

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from villages in Macha, Zambia (page 3, 'Study area').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting bioassays and genotyping on field-collected mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for Chidakwa and Lupata villages in Macha, Zambia (page 3, 'Study area').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in January 2010 (page 3, 'Study area').

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, independent collection of mosquitoes and LLINs in 2009-2010.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of LLINs in Macha, Zambia, and assessed insecticide resistance in the local Anopheles arabiensis population. The study found no kdr mutations (L1014F/S) in the population and high susceptibility to pyrethroids in bottle bioassays, though some reduced mortality was observed in ITN bioassays.
